6 DeviceDescription
The External Drainage System includes a tubing, drainage bag, drip chamber and
scale plate. It is provided sterile and can be connected to a drainage catheter, which is
connected to a patient line, via a luer connection and ultimately to a drainage bag.The
drainage catheter is not included in the subject device. The External Drainage System

K221694 Page 2 of 6
provides a closed system for the drainage of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) from the
ventricles of the brain or the lumbar subarachnoid space. During the draining, the
cerebrospinal fluid will becollected in adrainage bag.
7 IndicationsForUse
External Drainage System allowsfor drainage of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) from the
lateral ventricles of thebrain and the lumbarsubarachnoid space in selected patients
toreduce intracranial pressure (ICP).
